body: Long Beach Bond Finance Authority - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
LONG BEACH BOND FINANCE AUTHORITY AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 4, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 9:00 AM

Thomas B. Modica, Chairperson  Dawn McIntosh, Authority Counsel
Kevin Riper, Vice Chair & Executive Director  Monique De La Garza, Authority Secretary
Hank Kim, Treasurer/Auditor

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  JANETTE.QUEVEDO@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  23-51653  Recommendation to approve minutes for the Long Beach Bond Finance Authority
  Meeting of Thursday, March 30, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  23-51654  Recommendation to adopt resolution of the board of directors of the Long Beach
  Bond Finance Authority authorizing the execution of amendments to the existing
  Prepaid Natural Gas Purchase and Sale Agreement dated September 12, 2007
  between the Authority and Merrill Lynch Commodities Inc., and other documents
  and actions related thereto; and delegating authority to officers in connection
  therewith.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Long Beach Bond Finance Authority on non-agenda items. Each speaker
 is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
 prior to the meeting.

 NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
 https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
 Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Janette Quevedo at (562) 570-6632 or
 Janette.Quevedo@longbeach.gov.

  A motion was made by Member Riper, seconded by Member Kim, to approve

  and actions related thereto; and delegating authority to officers in connection
